geometry.proportions: The deep, open lower wrap is about one third of the instrument length in height. The bell flares more broadly than a trumpet.
geometry.partLayout: Carry the large bell branch around the rear bow and below the valve group. Connect the short straight leadpipe to the first valve and seat the three unequal vertical slides in the block.
